profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary:
My area of expertise is building data platform and provide analytical insight of the data to empower every individual and organization on the planet.

Familiar languages: Java, C#, Python, C++, Hack, Slang

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
2023 - current,  Ads ML Model Platform

Ads ML infra building next generation ML platform with accelerated PyTorch stack. 

2021-2023, Pytorch 

Focus on Pytorch GPU acceleration for Tensor based processing.
Helping to make AI accessible to every person and organization in a responsible way.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Federated Machine learning for Pytorch mobile.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Azure Cloud and AI platform.
 
I am working on Azure data platform to deliver seamless on demand scalable solution in exabyte scale and provide user insights and control to their data. My focus is in control plane of Azure SQL.

I am currently exploring the use of machine learning for smart deployment and auto performance tuning in Azure SQL.

I own an end to end project to improve Sql Azure reliability and customer satisfaction tracked by KPIs such as time to detect incident (TTD), time to notify customer (TTN), time to mitigate (TTM) and CSAT score. 

I delivered an one man project called customer lockbox. 
https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/fundamentals/customer-lockbox-overview
This satisfied a set of security requirements to provide transparency and control of data in Azure for customers. This contributed as part of the deal to acquire 330 million new revenue as well as part of $10 billion JEDI enterprise promise.

I contributed as an IC to deliver solutions for immutable log, zero touch operation, Application portability and adaptability for SQL Azure to satisfy JEDI requirements. 

I am serving as a tech lead in a virtual team for variety projects.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
GS Electronic Trading (GSET)

- Served as project lead on a project to build a distributed, low latency data pipeline with services and APIs for Atlas Algo engine using Coral block's low latency sequencer frameworks. It was built to support 200 million trades per day with strict high resilience requirements. (recoverable and replayable).

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
Lead developer for building Goldman's first Crypto currency and commodity trade flow (data pipeline) as part of effort to create new revenue stream.

Contributed as one of the main developers for Goldman's new generation large scale distributed data ingestion pipeline to scale trade flow capacity by 10x for Equity Synthetic products. 

Above projects are part of overall effort to increase 5 billion revenue firmwide.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: Saved our team 1.2 millions annual budget and achieved on-demand scalability by migrating entire derivative trade processing to on-prem cloud with no performance penalty in mostly one man project with collaboration with many different teams globally.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Pricing and feasibility System 
- Help increased revenue and EBITA by increasing bid/contract conversion rate. This is done by processing real time data and apply algorithmic strategies to produce product pricing and feasibility. 

- Pricing means suggested price.
- Feasibility is a set of indicators of how likely we are able to fulfilled the order within calculated price.

Automated sourcing system 
- Cost saving by automating traffic routing, project management, monitoring, reporting and alerting.

Main technology used are Java, C#, SQL Server.
